nodes.label: Why */15 not 0 * * * *
nodes.rationale: pg_cron schedules in GMT and Nepal is UTC+05:45, so an hourly job fires 45 minutes late every Nepal hour; */15 lands a tick exactly on the closing instant, worst case 15 minutes late.

nodes.label: has_variants trigger-maintained
nodes.rationale: rs_sync_has_variants trigger on menu_item_variants maintains has_variants; never set it by hand.

nodes.label: Variant price REPLACES item price
nodes.rationale: lib/order-items.ts resolves price = Number(v.price), not item.price + v.price; entering variant prices as differences silently overbills.

nodes.label: workstation_id derived from category
nodes.rationale: A BEFORE-INSERT trigger overwrites whatever workstation is supplied with the category's; the station must be set on the category, never the item.

nodes.label: A product's workstation is metadata, not mechanism
nodes.norm_label: a product's workstation is metadata, not mechanism
nodes.rationale: product_workstations is a nullable M2M with on delete cascade — a product with no station is ordinary, unlike menu items where the station is trigger-enforced and required.

nodes.label: D2: paid room bill missing money
nodes.norm_label: d2: paid room bill missing money

nodes.label: Discount-before-tax rule
nodes.rationale: buildFolio applied the discount before tax while BillTicket applied it after; unified to before-tax since arithmetic is identical today (tax=0) and correct if VAT is ever switched on.

nodes.label: Counters on line + append-only event log
nodes.norm_label: counters on line + append-only event log
nodes.rationale: The counter exists because PostgREST cannot aggregate a child table into an embed; the event log exists because stock_report dates a release by cancelled_at and one timestamp cannot date two partial cancels.

nodes.label: Releases got their OWN view, order_item_release
nodes.norm_label: releases got their own view, order_item_release
nodes.rationale: Emitting release legs from order_item_consumption would fan out N times and corrupt product_history's running balance; the new view joins the old rather than re-deriving the recipe rule.

nodes.label: Unit-wise cancellation: counters + event log, both
nodes.norm_label: unit-wise cancellation: counters + event log, both
nodes.rationale: The counter exists because PostgREST cannot aggregate a child table into an embed; the event log exists because stock_report dates a release by timestamp and one cancelled_at cannot date two partial cancellations.

nodes.label: Re-derive paid bill from frozen stay
nodes.norm_label: re-derive paid bill from frozen stay
nodes.rationale: check_out_at freezes the folio and room_rate was snapshotted at check-in, so a reprint recomputes the same numbers with no new storage.

nodes.label: Derived stock, not cached
nodes.rationale: No current_stock column; a cache drifts from the POS but a derived figure can't. No nightly rollover job needed.

nodes.label: Four derived balances
nodes.rationale: Cash, online, credit-to-us, credit-by-us are all derived by finance_report; only the opening seed is stored, so carry-forward can never drift.

nodes.label: Local JWT verification via getClaims()
nodes.rationale: No network getUser() call on the hot path (cached JWKS, WebCrypto); falls back to getUser() on verify error, never returns null.

nodes.label: Earlier feature: Cancel a checked-in stay
nodes.norm_label: earlier feature: cancel a checked-in stay

nodes.label: drop function before create on signature change
nodes.norm_label: drop function before create on signature change
nodes.rationale: Without the drop, a changed return type or argument list creates a second overload and calls fail with 42725 not unique.

nodes.label: Every new RPC param needs DEFAULT + named args
nodes.norm_label: every new rpc param needs default + named args
nodes.rationale: Migration 20260717140000 recorded that adding a parameter without a default broke every hotel credit checkout because the caller used positional arguments.

nodes.label: alter type add value must be alone in its file
nodes.norm_label: alter type add value must be alone in its file
nodes.rationale: The runner wraps each migration in begin...commit, and Postgres refuses to use an enum value added in the same transaction (55P04).

nodes.label: Enum ADD VALUE and its first use cannot share a migration
nodes.norm_label: enum add value and its first use cannot share a migration
nodes.rationale: Postgres rejects using a new enum value in the same transaction it was added in (55P04); baselining had hidden this bug because the file was recorded as applied without running.

nodes.label: In-place edit + audit, not reversal
nodes.rationale: Finance and stock are already derived from payments/purchase_items, so an edited row simply re-derives correctly; the audit log is the immutability guarantee.

nodes.label: Security PIN: in-place edit + audit, not reversal
nodes.norm_label: security pin: in-place edit + audit, not reversal
nodes.rationale: Finance and stock are already derived from payments/purchase_items, so an edited row re-derives correctly; void semantics would mean new bill/void numbers and teaching every report to net voids.

nodes.label: Latency-bound performance model
nodes.rationale: Every query is under 1ms server-side; the cost is ~130ms per round trip. Optimise by removing round trips, never by adding indexes.

nodes.label: cancelled_at keeps its exact old meaning
nodes.norm_label: cancelled_at keeps its exact old meaning
nodes.rationale: Stamped only when cancelled_quantity = quantity, so trg_release_ticket_numbers_on_item_cancel still releases the bill number on the last unit.

nodes.label: cancelled_at still means the WHOLE line is gone
nodes.norm_label: cancelled_at still means the whole line is gone
nodes.rationale: Stamped only when cancelled_quantity = quantity; redefining fully done as cancelled+served=quantity would silently stop bill numbers being released.

nodes.label: Compare-and-swap idempotency
nodes.rationale: The old model was idempotent structurally (cancelled_at is null); per-unit events make a naive retry cancel MORE, so CAS on the remaining count (p_expected_remaining) replaces it.

nodes.label: Partial cancellation refused not clamped; CAS not a key
nodes.norm_label: partial cancellation refused not clamped; cas not a key
nodes.rationale: A retry of cancel 2 would cancel two MORE under per-unit events; CAS on the remaining count needs no client state and also covers two cashiers cancelling concurrently.

nodes.label: Mock bills write NOTHING, structurally enforced
nodes.norm_label: mock bills write nothing, structurally enforced
nodes.rationale: No mock_bills tables; every app figure derives from payments/session_order_items/purchases/stock_adjustments, so a row never written is invisible to all of them by construction.

nodes.label: Emptied saving pot is CLOSED, not deleted
nodes.norm_label: emptied saving pot is closed, not deleted
nodes.rationale: A saving row IS an extra_expenses row already counted by a dated report; deleting it would silently rewrite a settled day's closing cash, which on delete restrict exists to prevent.

nodes.label: Reset keeps saving pots, folds balance onto opening_amount
nodes.norm_label: reset keeps saving pots, folds balance onto opening_amount
nodes.rationale: reset_restaurant_finance's established shape is keep the account, delete its transactions, carry the balance onto an opening term — the same pattern as products.opening_stock and vendors.opening_credit.

nodes.label: Accrual rule pointed the other way
nodes.norm_label: accrual rule pointed the other way
nodes.rationale: Cash lands the day taken; the sale books at checkout — the mirror of the app's existing credit accrual rule.

nodes.label: No back-dating rule
nodes.rationale: Back-dating would silently rewrite a business day whose PDF is already emailed and marked delivered in report_deliveries.

nodes.label: Saving as 11th category
nodes.rationale: Modeled as a category rather than a new table so the period total, split, ledger, CSV, PDF and profit subtraction all pick it up with zero changes to either finance function.

nodes.label: Completed: Thermal print page = printable head width
nodes.norm_label: completed: thermal print page = printable head width
nodes.rationale: An 80mm printer's head covers only 72mm; the page was authored at the roll width so the right ~8mm fell off the paper.

nodes.label: Assignment is single source of truth for dashboard visibility
nodes.norm_label: assignment is single source of truth for dashboard visibility
nodes.rationale: viewerSeesAllGroups returns true only for restaurant_admin; capability perms gate WHAT you may do but no longer WIDEN what you can see or touch.

nodes.label: delete_restaurant_cascade names extra_expenses/saving_titles explicitly
nodes.rationale: Two ON DELETE cascades whose relative order Postgres does not promise; naming them explicitly avoids depending on RI trigger name sort order, which breaks on a database rebuilt from scratch.

nodes.label: Ledger colours by direction, not kind
nodes.norm_label: ledger colours by direction, not kind

nodes.label: A saving is an extra expense with a pot
nodes.norm_label: a saving is an extra expense with a pot

nodes.label: A withdrawal is a negative saving row
nodes.norm_label: a withdrawal is a negative saving row

nodes.label: Cancelled stay: retained deposit is a SALE
nodes.norm_label: cancelled stay: retained deposit is a sale

nodes.label: Signed room_advances rows
nodes.rationale: Positive = deposit, negative = refund, so held on a stay = sum(amount) with no second table, refund flag, or refund branch in the finance cash legs.

nodes.label: is_custom explicit marker
nodes.rationale: Not inferred from menu_item_id IS NULL, because a deleted menu item also nulls it, making inference ambiguous for historical rows.

nodes.label: Withdrawal = negative saving row
nodes.rationale: The same signed-row trick as a room_advances refund; removes a second table, a direction flag, and any withdrawal branch from the finance functions.

nodes.label: Stock retro-deduction on linking a menu item
nodes.norm_label: stock retro-deduction on linking a menu item
nodes.rationale: Usage joined ALL past sales of a menu item when a product link was added, driving stock deeply negative; fixed with the load-bearing filter soi.created_at >= mip.created_at.

nodes.label: QR ordering modes (With PIN / Without PIN / Menu Only)
nodes.norm_label: qr ordering modes (with pin / without pin / menu only)

nodes.label: Sohne Thin Typography
nodes.rationale: Weight 300 with negative letter-spacing is the brand's editorial-density signature; bumping to 400+ collapses it.

nodes.label: Stripi Design Language
nodes.rationale: Financial-infrastructure brand: deep navy ink, electric indigo primary, atmospheric gradient mesh; Sohne thin type with negative tracking; tabular figures for money.

nodes.label: Gradient Mesh Backdrop
nodes.rationale: Primary depth medium instead of literal shadows; non-negotiable on marketing heroes; implemented as SVG/image, not a CSS gradient, because the real mesh has organic blob shapes.

nodes.label: Tabular-Figure Money Type
nodes.rationale: font-feature-settings: tnum on every money/numeric cell — the brand's quiet financial-data signal.

nodes.label: advance_amount lockstep invariant
nodes.rationale: left on credit = total_amount - (cash+online+card+advance_amount); every reader must move together or a bill silently raises phantom customer debt.

nodes.label: DB before app golden rule
nodes.rationale: Every migration is additive and RPC parameters always default, so migrating the DB first and deploying the app after keeps the currently deployed build working against the new schema.

nodes.label: Cancelling an item on a PAID bill is refused
nodes.norm_label: cancelling an item on a paid bill is refused
nodes.rationale: No refund/adjustment concept exists; getPaidBill re-queries items live so a post-payment cancel silently changed a printed bill while total_amount stayed frozen.

nodes.label: Self-hosted cutover complete 2026-08-27
nodes.rationale: The droplet (.env.hrestrosewa) is the only live database now; .env.production was never the live target and was renamed to .env.production(supabase) to prevent future confusion.

nodes.label: Self-hosted migration: replay migrations, copy data over Kong
nodes.norm_label: self-hosted migration: replay migrations, copy data over kong
nodes.rationale: Reach the DB through postgres-meta at Kong's /pg/query rather than SSH/exposed port; replay 72 migrations rather than pg_dump to avoid version skew; copy bcrypt hashes directly for logins.

nodes.label: Two Supabase projects (dev/prod)
nodes.rationale: .env.local = DEV, .env.production = prod, to isolate real data. Never append to an env file without a trailing newline.
